program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (/ (rows g) 2))
                  (hw (/ (cols g) 2)))
             (build-grid hh
                         hw
                         (r c)
                         (let* ((v (at g r c))
                                (v (if (!= (at g (+ r hh) (+ c hw)) 0)
                                       (at g (+ r hh) (+ c hw))
                                       v))
                                (v (if (!= (at g (+ r hh) c) 0) (at g (+ r hh) c) v))
                                (v (if (!= (at g r (+ c hw)) 0) (at g r (+ c hw)) v)))
                           v))))))
